name: VectorTiles
displayName: VectorTiles · QGIS project vector tile generation
description: Generate MBTiles vector tiles from QGIS projects and expose HTTP endpoints for clients.

en.description: Generates vector tiles from QGIS projects and exposes style, tilejson, and tile endpoints.
readme: Build vector-tile caches from selected project layers.
Use style and tilejson URLs directly in QGIS, Origo, MapLibre, or OpenLayers.
On-demand mode can generate missing tiles when uncached z/x/y is requested.
For production, pre-generate key zoom ranges to reduce first-request latency.

es.description: Genera vector tiles desde proyectos QGIS y expone endpoints de style, tilejson y tiles.
readme: Construye cache de vector tiles desde capas seleccionadas del proyecto.
Usa URLs de style y tilejson en QGIS, Origo, MapLibre u OpenLayers.
El modo on-demand puede generar tiles faltantes al pedir z/x/y no cacheado.
Para produccion, pre-genera rangos de zoom clave para reducir latencia inicial.
